bio.text: Andres Jinete is the Green Party candidate for New Jersey's 12th Congressional District.
Jinete, 29, was born and raised in Bound Brook, where he lives, and is a management student at Kean University.
WHYY reports that he has worked for ten years at libraries in the 12th District, is a member of the Central Jersey Tenant Union, and is a steering committee member of the Green Party's Latinx caucus.
